summary: Adversarial verification of wf/design/schemas.md (2,993 lines; 28 models, 22 product ports = 183 methods + 7 stand-in ports = 8 methods; count reproduced exactly). (a) 429 CONFIRMED copy/field/sample-value claims were grepped against the decoded v46 boards (heavily weighted to REQ, SACC, ACC, ASMT/ATT, SUB, UPD, DTR, FB, PER): no fabricated copy was found; about 420 hold as cited, the rest are on a different board than cited or are composed from templates. Two field-level [C] items do not hold as cited: the SACC 'Paused' grant label (not in the B2-04 LBL map; drawn only on B2-03, and B2-04's paused frame keeps 'Active') and the IA example name 'N. Joshi' (a request contact, not an Institute Admin). (b) Binding constraints largely hold: no Module anywhere, Programme only on StudentPerson, FormatCompletion written only by the runtime stand-in, no aggregate verdict, FB unique key (student, experiment, format) gated on FormatCompletion, licences typed Provided<number> with no arithmetic, publish/release create no grants, per-assessment Faculty rules with null defaults. There is one CRITICAL breach: DevIdentityPort (listSampleAccounts/switchTo) is a developer-only account selector that the owner explicitly banned and that B1-09 'Never here' lists. (c) 81 of the 85 distinct status words in frame-index.json appear verbatim, plus 2 trivial equivalents. The deliverable misses 'Can't open — inactive' (B2-06) and '1 to resolve: learning outcomes' (B6-06), and several script-only role words ('Not sent for review', 'Withdrawn by the Content Manager', 'Not submitted yet', 'Not available right now', 'Inactive — can't be given access'). (d) The transitions requested for checking match the permission evidence (CM send-back to reviewer/vendor, UPD withdraw in Draft/Returned/In academic review, Hold needs a reason, Lift hold before Release, DTR approve-only, override of stuck records only, Pause/Restore). The exception is the no-Institute-Admin device transfer, which the deliverable models as a refusal while B3-07 draws a request that exists but cannot be forwarded. (e) One drawn data-changing action has no method: the IA 'Open the payment page' on B3-08. The approveRequest side-effect row would downgrade an existing active external institution and silently decide OD-B3-09 for internal renewals. Four drawn failure states lack Unavailable. (f) Of the 71 prototype removedBehaviours, 66 are not resurrected and 2 are partial risks (the WorkflowRoutingPolicy fast-path branch and the DTR format input). Three are re-introduced as developer-surface controls: the actor switcher, the demo clock and the DEMO runtime simulator. (g) @xr/domain types import IsoInstant from @xr/validation, which the committed boundary matrix forbids ('@xr/domain': []). The required edits to TECHNOLOGY_META / DeliveryModel / ROLE_PLANNING_LABEL / SimulationStatus are not stated.

Of 35 first-pass misses, 26 are drawn but split by markup or built by templates; 7 are on a different board than cited (Arun wait note B2-06 not B2-05; 'No time limit and no timer.' B4-04 not B4-05; 'VR not started offers nothing' B8-04 not B3-06; 'In your bank · reviewed by you' B4-08 not B4-07; SSO label is 'Sign in with your institution'; 'Two of four answered' is caption wording; 'Four questions, 16 marks' is caption wording); 2 are not drawn as claimed (SACC 'Paused' from the B2-04 LBL; IAA example 'N. Joshi'). B1-09 'Never here: DEMO strips, sample accounts, a role switcher …'; B1-09 head-meta 'No sample accounts, no role chooser'.

checksRun.check: (c) Status enum coverage vs derived/frame-index.json statuses
checksRun.detail: 85 distinct drawn status words: 81 verbatim in the doc, 2 equivalent ('Returned to vendor · revision 1', 'Warning'), 2 missing ('Can't open — inactive' B2-06 f11; '1 to resolve: learning outcomes' B6-06 f2). Script/inconsistency words missing: B6-04 rvChipWords 'Not sent for review', 'Withdrawn by the Content Manager'; B4-13 'Not submitted yet'; B2-12 'A format not available right now'; B2-05 'Inactive - can't be given access'. Per-role label maps exist for REQ, INST, ACC, SUB, UPD, SACC, PER, RUN, ASMT/ATT, DTR (DTR verified against W/IAW/SAW). The SACC 'Paused' row is attributed to the wrong board.

Matched: CM send back to reviewer (no refs) / vendor (refs optional) from with-CM only; RV approve/return from with-AR incl. re-check; UPD withdraw in draft/returned/in-academic-review; Hold needs a reason; Lift hold has no reason, returns to awaiting, and there is no release from on-hold; DTR forward (IA, irreversible), approve only when forwarded (SA), no decline; SA override only for stuck with-AR and only to returned; Pause from active/ending soon, restore to previous; IA assign only when active/ending/paused and none assigned; scope restore with no reason. Exception: no-IA DTR (B3-07 'This request can't be forwarded yet … It stays here until one is assigned') is modelled as a refusal/blocker.

All 681 surface actions were scanned (wf/verify/_schemas/actions.txt); about 120 are data-changing. All map to a method except IA-17 'Open the payment page' (B3-08 'Approved - payment required (later sample)' → B1-08 PU-12), whose startPayment needs a public RequestStatusToken the IA does not hold. Side-effect defect: approveRequest row ('External → … INST approved-payment-required'; 'Internal → creates ACC') is not limited to new institutions. Drawn failure states without Unavailable: giveAccess (B2-05 f12), launchWebFormat (B3-03 f2), sendFeedback (B3-06 f2), submitAttempt (B4-12 f3). Error unions: every product write includes NotPermitted except continueStep, startPayment, reportProblem (and public selection, by design). InvalidState is missing on several writes with drawn state preconditions (saveMark/confirmMarks on an in-progress attempt, openCorrection, giveAccess, requestDeviceTransfer).

71 removed behaviours checked (wf/verify/_schemas/removed.txt). Resurrected: 'Prototype identity pointers / actor switchers' → DevIdentityPort; 'Demo expiry clock' → ClockPort.setSampleNow on a developer surface; 'DEMO CONTROL runtime-event simulator' / 'demo-runtime-simulator' → RuntimeReportPort driven from a developer surface (also ARCHITECTURE §14 at 1b090c9: 'no scenario selector, no demo clock, no stand-in controls in V2'). Partial risks: WorkflowRoutingPolicy branch {to:'with-content-manager'} = removed 'silent fast-path … skips the Academic Reviewer'; requestDeviceTransfer input 'format' vs removed 'technology scope selector' (ST-18 form draws only 'New device' and the optional note). The other 66 are absent (no Mark as done, no reason-less hold/withdraw/deactivate, no defaults 60/3, no decline, no half marks, no AI marks, no Programme FK, no group description, no SA platform-code writes, no CM in-place edits, etc.).

Role ids: the doc keeps PLATFORM_ROLES incl. 'tenant_admin' and adds ROLE_LABEL (owner decision flagged), but does not say to retire ROLE_PLANNING_LABEL ('Student / Learner', 'Institute Admin / Tenant Admin'). Format ids: it keeps Technology 'web'|'vr'|'mr'|'ar' and adds FORMAT_DISPLAY_ORDER, but leaves committed TECHNOLOGY_META (label 'Web'; names 'Virtual Reality'/'Mixed Reality'/'Augmented Reality'; DeliveryModel 'hosted'|'package') alongside a new FORMAT_META with a different delivery vocabulary ('web-link'|'app-package'). SimulationStatus 'NOT_STARTED'|'IN_PROGRESS'|'COMPLETED' is not reconciled with FormatProgressStatus. Boundary: §1.2/§5.1 put the §1–§2 types in @xr/domain but import IsoInstant from '@xr/validation'; boundary-matrix.mjs ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_DEPENDENCIES['@xr/domain'] = [] and resolved-boundaries.mjs checks ImportDeclaration (incl. type imports). The zod 4.6.0 and RHF/@hookform claims are correct.

corrections.problem: These ports re-introduce three removed prototype behaviours as developer-surface controls: the demo clock (setSampleNow), the DEMO runtime-event simulator (RuntimeReportPort) and payment simulation (PaymentOutcomePort). The committed architecture bans stand-in controls in V2, and the board controls they replace are declared 'not product'. Presenting a developer surface as the default plan pre-empts the owner.
corrections.evidence: functional-prototype.json removedBehaviours: 'Demo expiry clock … prototype-only'; 'DEMO CONTROL runtime-event simulator (Report a session only, Report a completed run …)'; 'Stand-in sources … demo-runtime-simulator'; 'Payment simulation screen as product'. git show 1b090c9:v2/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §14: 'no scenario selector, no demo clock, no stand-in controls in V2'. START-HERE Known exception 4: board controls ('Restart', 'Sample: …') are not product features.

Rely on §4.1 'State coverage', which already seeds every drawn state, so the running app needs no time travel, payment or runtime control. Move 'developer surface' into §8 as an explicit owner choice. The default answer should be 'none'; if the owner picks a surface, record the exception and its removal trigger.

corrections.location: §1.2 'import type { IsoInstant } from "@xr/validation"' together with §1.1 'packages/domain (proposed module: ids.ts)' and §5.1 '@xr/domain | TS types and brands of §1–§2'
corrections.problem: The proposed @xr/domain types (HistoryEntry.at, RecordMeta, every *At field) import from @xr/validation. The committed boundary matrix gives @xr/domain zero workspace dependencies, so lint and the boundaries test would reject this.
corrections.evidence: git show 1b090c9:v2/packages/config/eslint/boundary-matrix.mjs: ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_DEPENDENCIES = { '@xr/domain': [], '@xr/validation': [], '@xr/contracts': ['@xr/domain','@xr/validation'], … }. rules/resolved-boundaries.mjs checks every ImportDeclaration (type imports included). @xr/domain package.json has no @xr/validation dependency. validation/src/instant.ts: 'export type IsoInstant = z.output<typeof isoInstant>' (a zod-derived type).
corrections.correction: Declare a framework-free 'export type IsoInstant = Brand<string, "IsoInstant">' (and CalendarDate) in @xr/domain. Keep the zod codec (isoInstant / normaliseInstant) in @xr/validation, and let @xr/contracts map the wire string to the domain brand. Change the §1.2 import and the §5.1 table to say this. Do not widen the boundary matrix.

corrections.location: §3.4 approveRequest 'Side effects on other records' row (and approveSmallerScope 'as approveRequest')
corrections.problem: The row says 'External → REQ approved-payment-required, INST approved-payment-required, no ACC' and 'Internal → creates ACC from the request, INST access-active'. Nothing limits this to a new institution. Approving an additional-licences request from an existing external institution would put an active institution back to 'Approved — payment required'. Approving an internal renewal would mint a new ACC, which silently decides OD-B3-09 / T-07 / T-08. The M01 table (only 'on a new external institution') contradicts the row.
corrections.evidence: B3-08 frame 'Approved - payment required (later sample)': Godavari's more-licences request is 'Approved - payment required … Nothing changes until the payment is confirmed' while Godavari stays Access active (B2-01/B2-03). B1-11 REQ-0038 is an internal renewal for an institution with existing ACC-0081. OD-B3-09 is open. M01 transitions: '— → approved-payment-required | approveRequest … on a new external institution'.
corrections.correction: Split the row by request type. new-access from a new institution: as written. new-access from an existing institution, renewal, or additional-licences: INST status unchanged (it stays derived from the existing plans). External sets REQ to approved-payment-required, and payment then triggers the PaymentOutcomePort effect. Internal sets REQ to access-active, and the plan effect is 'policy-open: OD-B3-09' (no new ACC, no licence change) until the owner decides. Mirror the same split in the PaymentOutcomePort 'confirmed' comment and in M05's 'renewed' transition.

corrections.location: §3.4 AccessRequestService.startPayment(input: { token: RequestStatusToken … }); M03 transition 'approved-payment-required · payment-failed → payment-not-confirmed | startPayment | requester'
corrections.problem: A drawn data-changing action has no contract path. The Institute Admin's request detail offers 'Open the payment page' for its own approved, payment-required request, but startPayment accepts only the public visitor's session-held status token, which a signed-in IA never receives for an IA-17 request.
corrections.evidence: B3-08 caption 'Approved - payment required (later sample) — Provider-neutral payment page from Batch 1 (B1-08); nothing is added until payment is confirmed.' with button 'Open the payment page' → B1-08. surface-institute-admin.json IA-17 action 'Open the payment page (approved — payment required) → PU-12 payment page via B1-08'.
corrections.correction: Add an IA path: either startPayment(input: { requestId: RequestId; expectedRev }) resolved from the IA session (own institution, origin 'institute-admin'), or an IA read that returns the request's statusToken. Errors: NotPermitted | NotFound | InvalidState | StaleVersion. Change the M03 actor to 'requester (public token) · Institute Admin (own institution)', and list IA-17 among the startPayment screens.

corrections.location: §3.0 RefusalCode 'no-institute-admin' (copy row: Student 'can’t be forwarded yet'); §3.16 getMyDevice.blockedBy: 'institution-paused' | 'no-institute-admin' | null with canRequest; M23 UNRESOLVED OD-B3-05

Add a derived read fact, DeviceTransferView.forwardingBlocked: 'no-institute-admin' | 'institution-paused' | null, shown to the Student as the drawn notice. assignInstituteAdmin's side effects should note that open DTRs become forwardable.

corrections.location: §1.3 ROLE_LABEL; §1.4 FORMAT_META / FormatMeta.delivery; M17 FormatProgressStatus; M17 UNRESOLVED 'replaceable CompletionPolicy'; §8 items 2–4
corrections.problem: The deliverable adds parallel vocabularies without saying exactly what changes in the committed foundation. Committed TECHNOLOGY_META keeps label 'Web' and names 'Virtual Reality'/'Mixed Reality'/'Augmented Reality', with DeliveryModel 'hosted'|'package'. The new FORMAT_META uses 'Browser'/'Virtual reality'… and a different delivery enum ('web-link'|'app-package') for the same concept. ROLE_PLANNING_LABEL ('Student / Learner', 'Institute Admin / Tenant Admin') stays exported next to ROLE_LABEL. SimulationStatus 'NOT_STARTED'|'IN_PROGRESS'|'COMPLETED' coexists with 'not-started'|'in-progress'|'completed'. 'CompletionPolicy' is referenced but never typed.
corrections.evidence: git show 1b090c9:v2/packages/domain/src/technology.ts (TECHNOLOGIES ['web','vr','mr','ar']; TECHNOLOGY_META web label 'Web', vr name 'Virtual Reality', delivery 'hosted'|'package'; sortTechnologies). roles.ts (PLATFORM_ROLES incl. 'tenant_admin'; ROLE_PLANNING_LABEL). runtime/utilisation.ts (SimulationStatus; 'COMPLETED needs a completion event …'). B6-07 fmtName {WEB:'Browser', AR:'Augmented reality', VR:'Virtual reality', MR:'Mixed reality'}; B8-03 'Formats WEB · AR · VR · MR'.
corrections.correction: Add a §1.9 'Required foundation edits' list. (1) technology.ts: keep TECHNOLOGIES ids; add FORMAT_DISPLAY_ORDER; replace TECHNOLOGY_META.label with the code ('WEB'|'AR'|'VR'|'MR') and .name with the B6-07 fmtName words, or delete TECHNOLOGY_META in favour of FORMAT_META; reuse DeliveryModel 'hosted'|'package' instead of inventing 'web-link'|'app-package'; mark sortTechnologies as non-UI or reorder it by ADR. (2) roles.ts: keep or rename 'tenant_admin' (owner decision #2); remove or rename ROLE_PLANNING_LABEL so it cannot reach copy, and drop the 'Student / Learner' B2C wording. (3) utilisation.ts: make the read model's FormatProgressStatus the one UI status; map SimulationStatus to it only inside the future runtime adapter; define 'interface CompletionPolicy { isCompletion(e: RuntimeEventRecord): boolean }' or delete the reference.

corrections.location: §3.18 RuntimeReportPort.reportCompletion (no side-effect list)
corrections.problem: §3 promises a side-effect list for every method, but reportCompletion, the only completion writer, has none. A system completion changes several role views at once (BC-14).
corrections.evidence: B3-12 Flow-3 continuity: 'Completion from the simulation → Give feedback on WEB'; B3-10 'Completed' definition; B4-10 per-format 'Completed 14 Oct 2026'; B7-03 institution report 'WEB 4 started · 2 completed'.
corrections.correction: Add the side effects. FormatCompletion is created, first completion stands. The Student's format page, Simulation, Progress and Home Up next show 'Completed <date>' and the 'Give feedback on <FORMAT>' entry. Faculty FA-03/FA-20 per-format counts, IA-20 'Completed' and the SA-07 institution report change. Nothing else changes: no grant, no assessment, no other format.
